tasks.subject: [opencode-run-custody] [P1] Define the inert custody and stdio protocol
tasks.description:
Create a private Node-only @dorkos/test-utils/run-custody subpath with executable-compatible .mjs client and components, adjacent declarations and module-relative absolute asset resolution. Keep test-utils barrel and production startup free of custody implementation dependencies. Define RunSpawnPort.start(request, signal): Promise<RunChild> around resolved executable, argv, cwd, explicit environment, stdio and existing binary observer. Expose actual native PID/executable identity, optional writable input and readable output/error, latched spawn/exit/close and integrity facts, and idempotent stopAndJoin(reason, deadline). Do not fabricate ChildProcess or allow arbitrary caller-controlled kill identity. Make main and scope separate authenticated lifelines, established before native create, with no inherited copies in any child/wrapper/anchor; target stdin remains only target input. Explicitly own any resources acquired, stop late authorization/publication and make import inert.

Implement bounded binary lanes with 64 KiB frames and 256 KiB outstanding credit per stdin/stdout/stderr lane, independently monitored control/EOF, ordered bytes/EOF/error, input backpressure/end, early output, fast exit latch and honest transport loss. Keep spawn argv/env and stream content in authenticated memory; allow only bounded secret-safe metadata in receipts. Model never-acquired, spawn-failed, native-closed, cleaned-owned, unsupported and cleanup-uncertain distinctly. Latch primary failure independently of cleanup failures, including thrown undefined; independently attempt known cleanup. Use remaining original startup or operation deadline when one already exists. If none, independent owner loss or explicit close revokes acquisition. Keep separate later phase clocks. No deadline retry/ratchet or new pre-gate resources.

Acceptance: hermetic transport/unit tests cover independent main/scope loss, duplicate/late messages, expiration, stale generation, max frame/credit, fast error/no PID, exit before close, early output, caller close with unread output, bounded failure/dual-error paths and secret canaries. Import starts zero child/listener/network. Backend artifacts and real lifetime proof are separate.
tasks.activeForm: Defining the inert custody and stdio protocol

tasks.subject: [opencode-run-custody] [P2] Implement and prove the POSIX guardian and group anchor
tasks.description:
In private test-utils POSIX backend files, implement one lazy scope guardian outside a dedicated group, with a separately spawned detached group anchor. Guardian receives exclusive run-main lifeline and distinct authenticated scope/control channel. Anchor owns a separate authenticated guardian pipe; EOF from a dead guardian initiates its cleanup. Spawn the target into the anchor's own group with no new detach, no lifeline inheritance and actual target PID/identity observation. Anchor catches its own TERM, signals only its current group from inside, and escalates at most once at the fixed deadline. Guardian never signals a remembered negative PGID. Keep guardian alive to separately record anchor closure, actual native close/stream/integrity where observable, current group absence via nonsignaling observation and bounded uncertain outcomes. An exited leader must not suppress remaining owned member cleanup. Unknown anchor identity, reused group, access denied or unavailable observation never authorizes stale retry. Escaped descendants lie outside the cohort.

Respect 5,000ms host join limits, preserving manager 3,000ms TERM grace within that ceiling and immediate escalation for the existing eval kill path. Clip to any earlier enclosing deadline. Keep primary and cleanup failures and never delete uncertain artifacts. No process-name, worktree-path or bare-PID sweeps.

Acceptance: independently observed owned offline parent, scope, leader and ordinary descendant, with exact positive live identities before stimulus and unrelated owned positive remaining live. Prove normal/failure/timeout/SIGINT/SIGTERM/SIGKILL, parent kill before authorization and after spawn before ready, main loss with silent/blocked scope, scope loss with live main, late resolution, actual wrapper vs native PID, leader-exits-first and resistant descendant escalation. Prove real stream draining/backpressure. Green, remove only run-main-loss backstop, require intended still-live native assertion to fail with live subject even though silenced worker remains, let outer owner reap only recorded resources, then restore fresh green on actual eligible POSIX hosts.
tasks.activeForm: Implementing and prove the POSIX guardian and group anchor

tasks.subject: [opencode-run-custody] [P2] Build and prove the Windows Job guardian
tasks.description:

Build source-owned console PE with static CRT and required system libraries using VS 2022 and a proven supported SDK; expose package-local pnpm --filter @dorkos/test-utils build:run-custody:windows, never hook/postinstall/runtime download. Resolve explicit installed VS locator/VC environment and architecture-specific cl.exe output for x64, arm64, x86/ia32. Verify provenance and executable hash at package-relative resolution after gates. Keep production desktop/CLI packages unchanged; verify the same artifact is usable by source Vitest, emitted/workspace eval and tsx smoke. Missing/stale artifacts are explicit infrastructure failures.

Use one unnamed non-inheritable kill-on-last-handle-close Job held exclusively by the Win32 guardian. CreateProcessW uses STARTUPINFOEXW, EXTENDED_STARTUPINFO_PRESENT, explicit inheritable stdio allowlist, CREATE_SUSPENDED and creation-time PROC_THREAD_ATTRIBUTE_JOB_LIST. Preserve Windows 10/Server 2016 API floor, no suspended-create/later-assignment gap or unowned fallback, no breakaway. Authenticate named pipes with owner ACL/identity and fresh scope capability. Recheck both lifelines before ResumeThread. Retain actual process/thread handles separately from guardian or wrapper, use applicable normal stop then Job termination within current grace/join bounds, observe Job active count zero and exact individual handle waits. Completion-port messages only prompt observation. Nested-job denial fails closed, never bypass outer job. Keep exact environment and native identity.

Acceptance: prove on genuine x64 and arm64 Windows and eligible Node 22 ia32, with SDK/tool availability, architecture and oldest claimed floor recorded. Cross-build is artifact evidence only. Use offline outer observer with live known targets and retained exact HANDLEs to test before-resume/main loss, guardian death, normal shutdown, worker loss, no inherited Job/lifeline, Job membership, exited leader/descendant, nested failure and leak/breakaway negative controls. Source and emitted entrypoint helper presence and artifact integrity must pass. No product Windows x64 alpha claim or new Windows skip.

tasks.subject: [opencode-run-custody] [P2] Register run-main ownership in the server Vitest project

Setup creates owner-private metadata and an unrefed async poll, without helper, native process, listener, model or provider lookup. Worker requests only after existing gate. Validate capability/generation/deadline, use one sweep in flight and bounded fair processing per sweep. Default 25ms poll is implementation detail; no fixed configured-worker admission ceiling. Process next eligible requests until their original applicable deadline; never substitute a shorter handshake clock. Exact authenticated replies, claim once, expire entries cleanly, no late/watch-generation replay. Main starts guardian with exclusive main writer, scope connects on separate transport. Worker never inherits or can hold open main lifeline. Worker installs close/cancel before sending argv/env privately. Main teardown synchronously stops admission, closes lifelines, joins and removes inbox only when cleanup confirmed.

Acceptance: hermetic broker tests for fair scheduling under configured workers, stale, replay, invalid or canceled metadata, no argv/env/secrets, teardown races and no helper/listener for gate-refused worker. Under both root and direct server configurations, use the actual Vitest main and configured workers with an owned offline protocol endpoint or guardian fixture. Observe main-lifeline close at that fixture after the actual main exits while a silent or JS-blocked worker stays alive. Separately observe worker-channel close with main still live. Prove descriptor noninheritance and exact generation reset. This task establishes registration and close delivery at the broker boundary.
